## What is being counted? {#sec-counting}

Use the full-sided-wait model of @xue-zhong-2026 at order $n=1$: there are
three labelled ranks, and each meld is a triplet or one copy of every rank.
Let $C(q)$ count the multiplicity triples that are live full-sided waits at
copy cap $q$, allowing every meld count $m$. Each triple is counted once;
its size $3m+1$ determines $m$. Cyclically rotated triples are distinct hands.

The [existence theorem](arbitrary-cap.html) restricts $m$ to
$2\le m\le q-2$ when $q\ge4$. The complement involution in that note pairs
the counts at $m$ and $q-m$. Here we compute their total without listing
candidate hands.

::: {#thm-total}
## Total count

For $q\ge4$, the number of live hands is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}
C(3k)&=3k(k-1)(3k-2),\\
C(3k+1)&=3k\bigl(2k^2+(k-1)^2\bigr),\\
C(3k+2)&=3k^2(3k+1).
\end{aligned}
$$

The first case has $k\ge2$; the other two have $k\ge1$.
:::

For $q=4,5,6,7,8,9,10$, respectively, the totals are
$6,12,24,54,84,126,198$. These are totals across all meld counts, rather
than the count at one fixed $m$.

## A bijection with boxes {#sec-boxes}

For a hand $c$, let its distinguished rank be the unique rank congruent
to $\sum_i i c_i$ modulo three. The order-one characterization in the
structural library gives a complete test: a hand of size $3m+1$ is full-sided
exactly when it has at least one tile at the distinguished rank and at least
two at each other rank. Liveness adds $c_i\le q-1$.

Since $\sum_i c_i\equiv1\pmod3$, moving each coordinate cyclically forward by
one changes the weighted residue by one. Cyclic rotation preserves both
the threshold test and the copy bound. Exactly one of the three rotations
has distinguished rank three, so it suffices to describe that rotation and
record its cyclic position.

In this position the congruences become

$$
\begin{aligned}
c_1&\equiv c_2\pmod3,\\
c_3&\equiv c_1+1\pmod3.
\end{aligned}
$$

Together with $c_1,c_2\ge2$ and $c_3\ge1$, these force precisely the three
shapes in @tbl-boxes. Every parameter is a nonnegative integer. A side length
$L$ means the parameter ranges over $0,\ldots,L-1$; length zero means an
empty box.

::: {#tbl-boxes}

| $r$ | Hand | Box sides |
|:--------------:|:-----|:----------------------------|
| $0$ | $(3a+3,3b+3,3d+1)$ | $A_0,A_0,B_0$ |
| $1$ | $(3a+4,3b+4,3d+2)$ | $A_1,A_1,B_1$ |
| $2$ | $(3a+2,3b+2,3d+3)$ | $A_2,A_2,B_2$ |

The three disjoint boxes for distinguished rank three.
:::

The copy bound gives the side lengths

$$
\begin{aligned}
A_0&=\lfloor(q-1)/3\rfloor,& B_0&=\lfloor(q+1)/3\rfloor,\\
A_1&=\lfloor(q-2)/3\rfloor,& B_1&=\lfloor q/3\rfloor,\\
A_2&=\lfloor q/3\rfloor,& B_2&=\lfloor(q-1)/3\rfloor.
\end{aligned}
$$

Conversely, every point in any of these boxes satisfies the threshold and
copy bounds, has size one modulo three, and hence is a live full-sided wait.
The common residue selects the box uniquely; division by three recovers its
coordinates. The distinguished rank recovers the cyclic position uniquely.
This proves the asserted bijection.

::: {.proof}

The box volumes and the three cyclic positions give

$$
C(q)=3\bigl(A_0^2 B_0+A_1^2 B_1+A_2^2 B_2\bigr).
$$

Substituting $q=3k$, $3k+1$, or $3k+2$ into the six floor functions yields
@thm-total. The argument counts all integer points of rectangular boxes by
products of side lengths; it does not enumerate hands.
:::

## Keeping track of meld count {#sec-melds}

The box construction retains more information than the total volume.
In the first and third rows of @tbl-boxes, the meld count is $a+b+d+2$;
in the second it is $a+b+d+3$. Cyclic position does not change it.

Writing $G_L(t)=1+t+\cdots+t^{L-1}$ and $G_0(t)=0$, the bijection therefore
gives the counting polynomial

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal L_q(t)=3t^2\bigl(&G_{A_0}(t)^2G_{B_0}(t)\\
&+tG_{A_1}(t)^2G_{B_1}(t)\\
&+G_{A_2}(t)^2G_{B_2}(t)\bigr).
\end{aligned}
$$

Its coefficient of $t^m$ counts live hands with $m$ melds, and
$\mathcal L_q(1)=C(q)$. For example, $q=7$ gives
$\mathcal L_7(t)=6t^2+21t^3+21t^4+6t^5$, consistent with the complement
symmetry.

## When a fixed-meld count stabilizes {#sec-stability}

Without a copy cap, the structural library counts exactly
$\binom{3m-2}{2}$ full-sided waits for $m\ge2$. The live count reaches this
value at a precise threshold.

::: {#thm-stability}
## Sharp stabilization threshold

Fix $m\ge2$. At copy cap $q$, the number of live full-sided waits with $m$
melds equals $\binom{3m-2}{2}$ if and only if $q\ge3m-2$.
Below this cap the live count is strictly smaller.
:::

::: {.proof}

Every three-rank full wait of size $3m+1$ has $c_i\le3m-3$ for each rank.
The threshold test initially gives $c_i\le3m-2$ at a nondistinguished rank.
Equality would leave exactly one tile at the distinguished rank and two at
the other rank; the weighted residue is then incompatible with the chosen
distinguished rank, a contradiction. At the distinguished rank the other two lower
bounds already give $c_i\le3m-3$.

Thus $q\ge3m-2$ makes every full wait live. The full wait
$(3m-3,1,3)$ attains the coordinate bound, and is not live when $q<3m-2$.
In that case the live hands form a proper subset of the finite set of full
waits, so their count is strictly smaller.
:::

For instance, the counts at $m=2,3,4$ stabilize at caps $4,7,10$, reaching
$6,21,45$, respectively.

::: {#cor-six-top}
## Six hands at the upper endpoint

For every $q\ge4$, exactly six live hands have the largest possible meld
count $m=q-2$.
:::

The complement pairs this count with the count at $m=2$, which is already
stable at cap four. In particular, this endpoint count stays fixed even
while the total $C(q)$ grows cubically.

## Checked Lean sources {#sec-lean}

[OrderOneBoxes.lean](OrderOneBoxes.lean) proves the box equivalence,
the meld count of its encoded hands, the volume formula, and all three
quasipolynomial cases. [OrderOnePolynomial.lean](OrderOnePolynomial.lean) defines
the generating polynomial by summing one monomial per live hand. It proves the
displayed product formula, identifies each coefficient with the corresponding
live-wait cardinality, evaluates the polynomial at one, checks the $q=7$
example, and deduces coefficient symmetry from the complement bijection.
[OrderOneStability.lean](OrderOneStability.lean) proves the coordinate bound,
the sharp stabilization threshold, strict inequality below it, and the six-hand
upper-endpoint count.

The files use Lean 4.35.0 and the structural library at
[this revision](https://github.com/lunaluteus/ninegates-lean4/tree/7b379afe7f54f34c59c8abdfc8e6fa5f0bee952a).
With a built checkout of that library, run the
[companion checker](check-lean.py) from this SunQuarTeX repository:

```sh
uv run python examples/live-waits/check-lean.py \
  --library /path/to/ninegates-lean4
```

It compiles fifteen source modules in a fresh temporary directory with strict
linters, then audits ninety-one declarations. Only `propext`, `Classical.choice`,
and `Quot.sound` are permitted. Rendering the note does not perform this check.
These independent experiments remain separate from the pending library PR.

For higher orders, [the general stabilization note](copy-cap-stability.html)
gives the sharp threshold $q=3(m-n)+2$ for $n\ge2$ and $m>n$.
